extracted.name: Chilli-butter smashed radishes
extracted.description: Combine the mellowed flavour of cooked radishes with chilli butter for a sumptuous side dish. Not a radish fan? You'll change your mind after trying this recipe
ingredient_lines: 500g radishes leaves removed, smashed with the flat edge of a knife (or halved/quartered if you find this hard to do)
instruction_lines: Heat the butter in a small frying pan with the chilli flakes until it begins to foam and turn golden brown. Add the radishes and coat well in the butter, turning often until softened, about 10-15 mins.
Turn up the heat, add the lemon juice, let it sizzle, then season to taste and serve.
